title: Degree-two cross relation for normalized pulled quotients
statement: Let g : X → S be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], E a quasi-coherent module with quasi-coherent tensor pullback g*E [pqf-def-coherent, def-pc-module-pullback]. Put A=Sym(E) and A prime=Sym(g*E), with their fixed symmetric gradings [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra], P0=Proj_S A and T=Proj_X A prime [def-nagata-relative-proj], and structural maps p and p prime. Fix normalized tautological quotients D on P0 and D prime on T [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data]. Let b be graded pullback data [def-nagata-graded-algebra-pullback-data] with comparison j:T→P0 [prop-nagata-relative-proj-functoriality], such that on every affine pair W⊆g inverse U it sends iota(m) to iota of the restricted pulled section of m for every m∈E(U). Fix an equality e between the tensor pullbacks (j≫p)*E and (p prime≫g)*E. Let M=(j≫p)*E, P=j*D.line and Q=D prime.line; let q:M→P be the pulled quotient composed with the section-normalized composition isomorphism, and q prime:M→Q be the other normalized composition followed by D prime.quotient, after transport along e. For every open V of T and sections m,n∈M(V), one has q(m)⊗q prime(n)=q(n)⊗q prime(m) in (P⊗Q)(V), using the tensor of sections [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

source.place: Tags 01N2 (lemma-base-change-map-proj), 01NQ (lemma-relative-proj-base-change), 01NR (lemma-glue-relative-proj-twists), and 01OB (definition-projective-bundle), degree-one quotient normalization and its scalar-extension fraction formula

proof.text: Use the degree-two generator identity on affine opens U of S and W of T contained in (j≫p) inverse U.

The affine section comparison identifies M(W) with E(U) tensor over O_S(U) with O_T(W), and sends a pure tensor m tensor r to r times the restricted normalized pullback section of m. For arbitrary m,n∈M(W), lift them along this bijection and perform tensor induction on each. Zero and addition follow from bilinearity; on pure tensors the generator identity and commutation of the two scalar actions give equality.

For a point in an arbitrary open V, choose an affine base neighborhood in S and an affine W inside its inverse image intersected with V. Naturality restricts both quotient sections and their tensors to W. The affine result gives equality there; separatedness of the tensor sheaf gives equality on V.

theorem normalized_pullback_cross_tensor
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ S) (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    [((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E).IsQuasicoherent]
    (D : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient E)
    (D' : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E))
    (b : Scheme.GradedAlgebraData.PullbackData g (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E)
      (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E)))
    (hb : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : X.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (m : E.val.obj (op U.1)),
      b.map h (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(S, U.1) _ m) =
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(X, W.1) _
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSection g E U.1 m)))
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
        (b.relProjComparison ≫ (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom)).obj E =
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E)).relProjHom ≫ g)).obj E) :
    let T := (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E)).relProj
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
      (b.relProjComparison ≫ (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom)).obj E
    let P := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback b.relProjComparison).obj D.line
    let q : M ⟶ P :=
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSectionComp b.relProjComparison
        (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).hom.app E ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback b.relProjComparison).map D.quotient
    let q' : M ⟶ D'.line := (eqToIso e).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSectionComp
        (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E)).relProjHom g).hom.app E ≫ D'.quotient
    ∀ (V : T.Opens) (m n : Γ(M, V)),
      Scheme.Modules.tmulSection (q.app V m) (q'.app V n) =
        Scheme.Modules.tmulSection (q.app V n) (q'.app V m)
